model_annotation:
The two plots illustrate the training rewards for different models on easy and hard training sets over a range of steps. Both plots share the same x-axis and y-axis labels, with the x-axis representing "Steps" and the y-axis representing "Training Rewards". The x-axis is linear, ranging from 0 to 500 with a tick label interval of 100, while the y-axis is also linear, with the top plot ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 with a tick label interval of 0.2 and the bottom plot ranging from 0.0 to 0.2 with a tick label interval of 0.1.

The top plot compares the training rewards for "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" models on the easy training set. The "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" model is represented by a blue solid line, starting at approximately 0.0 at 0 steps and increasing to around 0.3 at 200 steps, then remaining relatively steady with some fluctuations, reaching about 0.32 at 500 steps. The "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" model is represented by a red solid line, starting at 0.0 at 0 steps, rising to approximately 0.25 at 150 steps, and continuing to increase gradually to around 0.35 at 500 steps.

The bottom plot compares the training rewards for "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" and "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" models on the hard training set. The "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" model is represented by a blue solid line, beginning at 0.0 at 0 steps, peaking at around 0.05 at 50 steps, and then declining to approximately 0.01 at 500 steps. The "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" model is represented by a red solid line, starting at 0.0 at 0 steps, increasing to about 0.1 at 150 steps, and continuing to rise gradually to around 0.18 at 500 steps.
